name: sOU Default HUD
releaseNotes:
HUD API v3 migration with SDK-owned sessions and selective rendering. Requires sOU 0.3.34 or newer.
Optional horizontal playercards with full-card health backgrounds, left observer slots and bottom-aligned compact dead cards.
Modular SCSS and consolidated presentation logic; legacy preview sessions are Debug-only.
Fix: explicitly cleared panel captions remain empty.
